specName: Shell Action Bar for Non-Inventoried Labels
request: read through #attachment:005-shell-action-bar as i want to no do the same thing to Module_Dunnage.  ask your clarrification ?s before you begin
expectations: Receiving strip behaviour is unchanged apart from repairing settings hub cards that open the wrong page
Manual mode removal applies to Non-Inventoried Labels only, not to Receiving
No new permission model; search reuses the access rules navigation already enforces
Modules outside Receiving and Non-Inventoried Labels gain no mode controls and no behaviour change beyond accurate search entries
context: area: specs/005-shell-action-bar (spec, plan, per-page matrix the Dunnage work mirrors)
area: MainWindow.xaml.cs shell action bar resolution, mode shortcuts, and the hand-maintained search destination list
area: Module_Dunnage workflow view, mode selection view model, workflow service, step enum, and settings keys
area: Module_Settings.Receiving and Module_Dunnage settings hubs (card to step resolution)
constraint: shared strip only, no second strip; mode group must carry the owning module's own modes
constraint: Non-Inventoried Labels keeps Guided, Edit, Image Search; manual mode deleted entirely
constraint: MySQL writes stay stored-procedure only and Infor Visual stays read-only
constraint: page behaviour stays behind view models; no business logic in code-behind

intent: Move Non-Inventoried Labels navigation into the existing shared shell action bar, delete its mode-selection screen and manual mode, and make settings cards and global search accurate app-wide.

decisions.decision: Add a fourth entry-mode slot (ImageSearch plus IsImageSearchDefault) to the shell snapshot, the shared projection, and the strip XAML
decisions.why: The spec forbids a second strip and requires the mode group to show the owning module own modes; one extra slot per layer delivers that and leaves the Receiving snapshot equivalent
decisions.rejected: Replacing the fixed slots with an ordered collection and a repeater, which rewrites the strip and the 005 tests for two modules that need five slots between them

decisions.decision: Move Back, Next, Review, Save, and the mode-entry verbs into ViewModel_Dunnage_WorkFlowViewModel and hand it the hosted child view models through AttachShellActionHosts
decisions.why: The shell can only reach provider commands, and the page conditions the strip must honour are only visible from the page
decisions.rejected: Keeping the code-behind handlers and letting MainWindow call into the page, which the shell cannot see and which FR-026 and FR-034 forbid

decisions.decision: Select Type offers Next, enabled once a type is selected, and type cards keep auto-advancing
decisions.why: The per-page matrix lists Next there and FR-014 requires it gated on a chosen type; after Back from Select Part the type is still selected so Next is the way forward again
decisions.rejected: Omitting Next and deviating from FR-017, or stopping card auto-advance so Next is the only way forward, which costs every operator a click on every entry

decisions.decision: Back on Image Search returns to the guided step the operator came from, defaulting to Select Type when Image Search was the starting mode
decisions.why: Image Search has no predecessor inside the walk, so a fixed destination is wrong in one of the two ways it can be reached
decisions.rejected: Always returning to Select Type, which discards guided progress when the operator pressed Image Search mid-walk

decisions.decision: Strip copy comes from a new DunnageSettingsKeys.UiText group with today wording as defaults and one manifest entry each, and the save verb defaults to Save
decisions.why: Mirrors the Receiving shell keys so both modules are maintained the same way and satisfies FR-022
decisions.rejected: Resource files, which give a second inconsistent place to change operator text; the pinned Verbatim Constraint Save overrides the replaced Save All and Save Changes wording

decisions.decision: Delete manual mode outright: both enum members, both view models, both views, the ModeSelection shortcut key, the help topics, and the registrations, and correct a stored manual default to guided on open
decisions.why: FR-011 says no step or screen may implement it and FR-012 asks for the stored value to be corrected
decisions.rejected: Keeping the enum members and refusing navigation, which leaves a compiling route that every later switch must carry

decisions.decision: Keep the hand-maintained search catalog and fix what the audit found: one shared route opener carrying the scanner gate and leave confirmation, scanner entries filtered by the policy, ReconciliationLauncherPage added, and View_Settings_Dunnage_LabelPaths registered
decisions.why: The requirements ask for completeness and accurate access rules, not a new mechanism, and the drift came from four specific omissions
decisions.rejected: Generating the catalog by reflection, which replaces an auditable list with machinery that cannot express which pages are inner guided steps

decisions.decision: Resolve every Dunnage settings hub card by the exact step title in its Tag and add a Label Files card
decisions.why: FR-028 requires resolution by name rather than position, and the Label Files page exists and was offered in search with no route from its hub
decisions.rejected: Leaving Dunnage positional because it currently works, which leaves the two hubs maintained by two different rules

decisions.decision: Delete the mode-selection tests, re-point the workflow view model tests off the deleted neutral step, and add Dunnage shell action and default-mode test files beside the Receiving ones
decisions.why: The deleted screen tests assert a screen that no longer exists and the workflow tests would not compile, while the new files mirror how Receiving is verified
decisions.rejected: Extending the Receiving shell tests to cover Dunnage, which would need both modules fixture graphs in a file named for one of them

decisions.decision: Keep NavigateToRouteTagAsync as the single opener and route the navigation pane through it
decisions.why: one opener carrying the scanner gate and the leave confirmation, with no rename rippling into MainWindow.xaml.cs
decisions.rejected: Adding a second OpenRouteAsync method and deleting the old name

decisions.decision: Filter offered search results through a static FilterOfferedResults(matches, isScannerAllowed)
decisions.why: the allow-list only removes the scanner entry, so the list needs no change when it grows, and the rule stays testable without a window instance
decisions.rejected: Filtering inside GetSearchMatches, which is static and cannot see the current policy state

decisions.decision: Move the navigation verbs and the details Review flow into the Dunnage workflow view model, with two small hooks the page assigns in its constructor
decisions.why: the strip can only reach a provider command, and the page still owns the leave confirmation and the details text commit
decisions.rejected: Keeping the handlers in code-behind and letting MainWindow reach into the page

decisions.decision: Give the Dunnage mode builder an explicit showDividerAfter parameter
decisions.why: the Receiving helper sets ShowDividerAfter from canBeDefault, which copied verbatim draws a trailing divider after Image Search

decisions.decision: Detach the strip when a page supplies no provider
decisions.why: FR-002 and FR-035 require the strip to collapse so the page takes the full height; without the detach the previous page strip stayed on screen

decisions.decision: Register the Receiving and Volvo Label Files pages in dependency injection
decisions.why: the catalog test showed search offered three settings pages that were never registered and so could not open
decisions.rejected: Excluding them from the catalog assertion

decisions.decision: Trim the mode-selection shortcut assertions and service wiring in Phase 1
decisions.why: deleting the settings key made the tree unbuildable otherwise; Phase 5 finished the removal
decisions.rejected: Leaving the tree red between phases

decisions.decision: Bind the strip buttons enabled state from the snapshot instead of relying on each command CanExecute
decisions.why: the provider computes gates from hosted view models, so the snapshot is the one place that knows them
decisions.rejected: Giving every slot command a CanExecute predicate and notifying it

decisions.decision: Check settings page dependencies by reading each view model constructor against the registrations rather than building a service provider in the test
decisions.why: the app host registers logging, IConfiguration and IHostEnvironment outside the module registration, and resolving pages would drag that whole composition into a unit test
decisions.rejected: Resolving every settings view model from a hand-built provider

plan.summary: Planned the Non-Inventoried Labels strip by extending the existing shell chain with one ImageSearch mode slot, moving the Dunnage verbs into its view model, deleting manual mode and the mode-selection screen, name-resolving both settings hubs, and repairing the search catalog access and completeness gaps
plan.key_finding: The strip already reaches any page that implements IViewModel_ShellActionProvider, so the feature is one extra mode slot in core plus a Dunnage provider; the harder half is that every Dunnage verb lives in view code-behind reaching through XAML element names, and the search path opens routes without the scanner gate that navigation applies

tasks.summary: 70 tasks in 11 phases: the settings copy surface, a fourth mode slot through core and the strip, the Dunnage provider that fills it, the startup decision, the manual-mode deletion, then the P2 and P3 stories and Polish

implement.summary: Two independent reviews at the high tier ran; their three high-confidence findings (slot enabled state, unresolved Label Files services, Image Search return step) are all fixed and re-verified

converge.summary: Converge assessed the built spec against 35 functional requirements, 11 measurable outcomes, 33 acceptance scenarios and 11 edge cases; every area passed except FR-030/SC-008, so exactly one task (T071) was appended to close that gap.
converge.key_finding: FR-030/SC-008: View_Settings_Receiving_VendorVariables (Custom Vendor Variables) and View_Settings_Receiving_WeldedParts (Welded Part Numbers) are reachable from the Receiving settings hub but absent from the search catalog, and SearchDestinationCatalogTests cannot detect that class of gap.
checks: 8 plan decisions checked; the 18 recorded implement decisions left alone
7 constitution principles checked - no violation (Principle III remains the plan-recorded justified exception)
appended: New '## Phase 12: Convergence' section with exactly one task, T071: add a search destination for View_Settings_Receiving_VendorVariables (Custom Vendor Variables) and View_Settings_Receiving_WeldedParts (Welded Part Numbers), with aliases matching the card titles, and extend SearchDestinationCatalogTests to compare every card title on the Non-Inventoried Labels and Receiving hubs against the catalog (FR-030, SC-008)
dismissed_concerns: T069 code-level spot check: dismissed - no provider exists outside the two modules and TrackShellActions detaches on every navigation
No navigation-level test for the strip detach: dismissed - behaviour verified in MainWindow.TrackShellActions and ViewModel_Shared_ShellActionBar.Detach
Hard-coded save-complete and clear-confirmation dialog copy: dismissed - FR-022 is scoped to strip labels and tooltips, and the plan pins exactly seven Dunnage.UiText keys
Label Files DI registrations outside the named files: dismissed - recorded decision, required by FR-030/FR-031
FR-013 divider wording: dismissed - superseded by 005's FR-032 and encoded in T014; the code draws the divider between Back and Next

approach: Extend Model_ShellActionBarState and the shared projection with an ImageSearch slot and default flag, render a fourth chip in MainWindow, and implement IViewModel_ShellActionProvider on ViewModel_Dunnage_WorkFlowViewModel, whose verbs move out of the page code-behind and whose children arrive through AttachShellActionHosts. Delete ModeSelection and ManualEntry across enum, views, view models, shortcuts, help, and DI, with StartWorkflowAsync falling back to Guided and correcting a stored manual value. Then name-resolve both settings hubs and route search and the navigation pane through one opener that carries the scanner gate.
